answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Cap admissions per endorser at 4 per epoch and weight endorsements by distance from the trusted core. A cluster of 500 self-endorsing aliases collapses to one share of emission, because the graph, not the key count, decides who is real. Fresh keys with no genuine links stay distant no matter how many exist. The oasis test is the live device, the ledge test is the locked stake, and the nectar test is the graded history no template can fake. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
